title: Unang Sai Holsoan Ho
chord: Eb · G · Am · F · C · G · F · Eb
lyrics:
Unang sai holsoan ho, sumarihon hosam
Tu abit sipanganon unang susa roham
Ai Debata Amanta na sumarihon ho
Ai gari angka bunga, sai diparulosi do
Amporik leangleang, diparmudu Debata
Tu Tuhan Debatangku marendeende au

Sasude holsoholsongku, dipadao sian au
Sasude holsoholsongku, dipadao sian au
Tangihon HataNa i, bolongkon holsomi
Pasahat ma ngolumi tu Debatanta i
Tuhan na sumarihon na tinompaNa i

Amporik leangleang, diparmudu Debata
Tu Tuhan Debatangku marendeende au

Sasude holsoholsongku, dipadao sian au

Pangido tu Debata Pardenggan basa i
